ios.desc:
Stop juggling scattered notes across multiple apps. OktoNote's AI transforms any input - text, voice, photos, documents - into beautifully organized knowledge cards that work completely offline.

  AI-Powered Smart Organization

  Our advanced AI instantly analyzes your content and creates organized knowledge cards across 10 intelligent categories. No manual sorting required - just capture your thoughts and let AI do the
  work.

  Capture Everything, Anywhere

  • Voice Notes - Record thoughts on the go with automatic transcription
  • Photo Capture - Snap images with OCR text extraction
  • Document Upload - Import PDFs, Word docs, spreadsheets
  • Quick Text - Fast typing with rich formatting
  • Multi-modal - Combine text, voice, and images in one note

  10 Smart Knowledge Categories

  Tasks - Things to remember with no deadlines. Perfect for ongoing projects and ideas you want to act on later.

  Todos - Time-sensitive tasks with specific deadlines. Automatic deadline detection helps you stay on track.

  Journal - Capture memories, experiences, and life moments. Record vacations, amazing meals, or daily reflections.

  Links - Save and organize websites, articles, and online resources with automatic descriptions and previews.

  Attachments - Organize files, photos, audio recordings, and documents with smart categorization.

  Itinerary - Travel plans, schedules, and event planning with time-based organization and location awareness.

  Lists - Grocery lists, packing lists, movie watchlists, book recommendations - any collection of items.

  Discussion Notes - Meeting notes, interview summaries, and collaborative conversations with participant tracking.

  Details to Remember - Phone numbers, account info, passwords, and important facts about people and places.

  Study - Research materials, learning notes, and knowledge building with cross-referencing and topic organization.

  Key Features That Set Us Apart

  Offline-First Design
  Work completely offline - no internet required. All content syncs seamlessly when you're back online.

  Intelligent Search
  Find anything instantly with AI-powered semantic search that understands context, not just keywords.

  Beautiful Timeline View
  Browse your knowledge chronologically with an interactive timeline that makes discovering old content delightful.

  Feed & Card Interface
  Elegant card-based design inspired by paper notebooks with automatic dark/light modes.

  Privacy Focused
  Your data stays on

show_hn.title: Show HN: An app for people who like to note down things, but hate organising it

quotes.text:
Have you ever wanted to jot something down - tasks you wanted to do, just journal your ideas and thoughts, lists you wanted to remember, links you wanted to bookmark for later, pdfs with event tickets or travel that you wanted to find later, photos with details you need for later? or just speak and have that info findable later.

The problem is you couldn't. If you even wanted to find that information later, you need to organize them into folders and add important keywords so its findable in search.

If you wanted to create tasks or lists, you had to go and create one by one so its visually readable.

For files that you want to find later, you had to put it in your phone files or in drive. Now you know the tickets dont have proper file names. How are you going to find it unless you organized into folders?

Its 2025 and with AI you don't have to do all these anymore.

OktoNote takes care of all this for you. Your quick things to jot down, voice recordings, files, photos all of it can be uploaded to OktoNote and it takes care of understanding the context, organizes for you in beautiful cards, actionable for certain categories like tasks, searchable with related words not just exact keywords, and a timeline view to fully see the things you posted in order.

You don't have to worry about creating a title, organizing them into folders so you can try to find them when you need it. OktoNote takes care of organizing from your clutter of thoughts, ideas and things to remember.

Have you ever wanted a note taking app that you can just post and forget? And the content you posted is available for you when you need it, easily findable?

OktoNote takes care of that for you. Your quick things to jot down, voice recordings, files, photos all of it can be uploaded to OktoNote and it takes care of understanding the context, organizes for you in beautiful cards, actionable for certain categories like tasks, searchable with related words not just exact keywords, a timeline view to fully see the things you posted in order.

You don't have to worry about creating a title, organizing them into folders so you can try to find them when you need it. OktoNote takes care of organizing from your clutter of thoughts, ideas and things to remember.

Some highlights:

Journal cards - Becomes a diary for your thoughts everyday

Tasks / Todos - Actionable cards to keep your things to do

Lists - Manage your purchase list, recipes etc.,

Itinerary - Becomes a log for all your events, travel etc., (BTW You can just share from any app and OktoNote converts it into cards extracting all required info)

Details to remember - Keeps the info of your wifi passwords, room codes, contacts etc.,

Study cards - Creates a summary of all your learning content and merges them into a single card when same topic making it a great tool for learning new topics, languages etc.,

Discussion notes - Just record your discussion and it creates a summary with action items
